text:
Talia: quick heads-up 13 spike on embeds when customers mix 512 and 2048 dims in one request. runtime rejects.

Omar: is it a byte-limit 413 or shape-guard?

Talia: both. our splitter expects uniform dims and then hit payload cap.

Nina: immediate mitigation: return 413 + header X-Embed-Preflight with compact plan '512:120,2048:5;units=??'. SDKs can auto-split.

Rob: prefer header over new endpoint. cheaper to implement and backwards compatible.

Omar: agree. keep parser tiny (CSV style). avoid JSON in header for perf.

ConsoleUX: Console can surface the header in the request inspector and show estimated unit/cost delta. We'll add a small card behind FF.

InfraBot: deploy embed-edge v2.4 canary started :rocket:.

Talia: telemetry must include embed.preflight.advised and embed.preflight.accepted with tenant_hash and shapes.

Nina: routing rule: if tenant > 5 preflight rejects/min, flip route to small-batch pool for 10m. emit embed.shape_throttle metric.

Rob: billing: bill child split requests. annotate original request in audit logs.

Omar: rollout plan: flag 'embed_preflight_hint' at 5% tenants, monitor preflight.accepted and worker OOM.

Talia: I'll file RFC + minimal header spec. Nina/Rob to review.

Nina: will add SDK helpers for auto-split and retry.

Rob: noted. landing plan looks good. thread anchor 1735555555.
